topic: Electric vehicle battery recycling and second-life batteries

entity_types.ORGANIZATION: Companies, start-ups, OEMs, research institutes (e.g. Redwood Materials, Tesla)
entity_types.GOVERNMENT: Countries, regulators and agencies (e.g. European Commission, US DOE)
entity_types.REGULATION: Laws, directives, standards, subsidies (e.g. EU Battery Regulation, Inflation Reduction Act)
entity_types.TECHNOLOGY: Recycling or battery technologies (e.g. hydrometallurgy, direct recycling, LFP)
entity_types.MATERIAL: Raw or recovered materials (e.g. lithium, cobalt, nickel, black mass)
entity_types.CONCEPT: Ideas, markets and metrics (e.g. circular economy, recovery rate, second-life use)

relation_types.DEVELOPS: ORGANIZATION/PERSON develops or uses a TECHNOLOGY
relation_types.SUPPLIES: ORGANIZATION supplies MATERIAL or batteries to another ORGANIZATION
relation_types.PARTNERS_WITH: ORGANIZATION collaborates or has a deal with another ORGANIZATION
relation_types.REGULATES: GOVERNMENT/REGULATION sets rules or targets for an ORGANIZATION, MATERIAL or CONCEPT
relation_types.FUNDS: GOVERNMENT/ORGANIZATION finances an ORGANIZATION or FACILITY
relation_types.LOCATED_IN: FACILITY/ORGANIZATION is located in a GOVERNMENT (country/region)

questions: Which companies lead EV battery recycling and what technologies do they use?
How do regulations in different regions shape battery recycling?
Which materials are recovered and what are the main economic or technical challenges?
